rationale: It is the explicit membership of a deterministic initial wave. Keeping it in the immutable plan makes scheduling auditable without reconstructing wave partitioning from nested runs and shards.
alternatives: derive from runs[].shards, which would discard the declared initial partition
rename to shards, which would obscure that entries are digest references
simplestChoice: Keep shard_digests as the ordered shard-digest references for a wave.
